## Summary

**Shorten long identifiers and add copy actions**

Full UUIDs, hashes, git IDs and paths break selector and table density.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P0**
- Wave: **V1**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P0-06`
- DUX code: `DUX5-06`

## Scope

All dashboards; selectors, Run identity and forensic tables.

Screenshot groups: SG-01..SG-07 selectors + identity tables

## Concrete change

Use short form, monospace, Copy action and tooltip/drawer for full value. Keep exact-run identity in URL/control-plane APIs, not Prometheus labels.

## Expected effect

Context remains available without dominating layout.

## Acceptance criteria

- Run/Manifest IDs display 8+…+5 characters; full value copies exactly; no high-cardinality metric labels added.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Grafana data links / control-plane API.

## Risk

Copy action implementation differs by panel plugin.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Related to DUX4-25/30 density; adds short-ID + Copy without Prom cardinality.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
